acceptance: Reference-guided candidate rebuild. Current exported assets and context proofs are pinned; final user visual review remains open.
generation_recipes_scope: Includes historical generation studies and the current pinned master records. Current source selection is established by the producing manifest and its exact SHA256 pins; historical records are unchanged.

hamlet_context.purpose: actual hamlet PNG replacing the base center of a correctly gated forest-clearing fixture; graphics-only scale/context review
hamlet_context.rebuild_status: Historical fixture preserved from the previous source set. Pixels and hashes were not refreshed by this rebuild; re-review is required.

limitations: Recurring crown neighborhoods remain visible at larger patch scale; four crown shapes and periodic template are provisional.
Summer currently reads as open mixed woodland, not closed canopy. Full-map density, variation and unit readability need review.
Forest/base contexts cover grass or snow only; other ground transitions, fractional zoom, native mapping and runtime/release acceptance remain open.
original_image_inputs_scope: Semantic visual references used to paint the current masters or their fixture ground. Originals remain reference-only and are not bundled as runtime PNGs; source masters are newly painted. Unit sprite planes retain their existing independent artwork provenance.
ownership: Final pixel centers use polygon (25,0),(71,0),(96,40),(71,80),(25,80),(0,40). Complementary top-left half-open ownership: cross(edge,point)>0; edge ties include dy<0 or dy==0 && dx>0. Owned alpha 255; outside zero RGBA. Crop/filter before this final mask.

previous_acceptance.scope: Historical source set before the current redraw; not an approval of the current artwork.
previous_acceptance.text: Reference-guided candidate rebuild. Current exported assets and context proofs are pinned; final user visual review remains open.

profile:
forest-v1: bounded offline context exporter for forest,forest_w,grass,grass_w only. Ordered neighbors NE,SE,S,SW,NW,N; full lowercase SHA256 of forest-v1
season=<season>
center=<id>
NE=<id>
SE=<id>
S=<id>
SW=<id>
NW=<id>
N=<id>
, literal LF after each line. Base descriptors normalize all six effective neighbors. Four equal square row-major atlas panels: broadleaf-a,broadleaf-b,conifer-a,conifer-b. Whole panels uniformly resize with alpha-aware Lanczos3 to 96x96 RGBA (24 world pixels at 4x). No foliage rotation, mirroring or averaging. One pinned 36-point quarter-grid periodic template, min spacing 10 world pixels including all six neighboring copies; index modulo four fixes species in both seasons. Whole instances from seven sites are sorted by absolute y,x,point index,translation. Omit entire instance when its center's distance to any BASE FILLED polygon is <= R+4+1.5*sqrt(2), R=hypot(12,12); diagonal 4x->2x Lanczos support preserves the final four-world-pixel quiet band. No fade or clipped crown at a base boundary; no generic base frame in homogeneous forest. Seven sites suffice on P expanded by Euclidean distance 4: omitted generation cell min distance 42>R, omitted base min distance 42>2R+4+1.5sqrt(2)=40.0624. Summer ground uses unmirrored lattice-periodic sampleGrassMaterial; winter retains unchanged sampleConnectionMaterial. Ordinary Over whole RGBA crowns onto opaque 416x352 4x overscan, no pre-mask; whole unmasked Lanczos3 reduction to 208x176; crop then final complementary half-open ownership. Context keys are not runtime IDs. This bounded exporter and these fixtures do not implement arbitrary-map runtime context selection. Summer grass: unmirrored periodic bilinear source sampling. Per source axis, overlap=(size-1)/4 and span=3*(size-1)/4. At world phase t in [0,period), x=t/period*span. For x<overlap blend source(x+span) toward source(x) with cubic smoothstep(x/overlap); otherwise source(x). Apply separable windows on both axes, periods142,80. Round wrapped world phases to1e-9 before source lookup. Average RGB of f(x,y),f(x+71,y+40), then round half-up once. This is invariant under all six neighbor translations without reflected source marks. Non-grass materials, unseen and winter retain the existing sampler. Optional summer profile canopy-26.5-30-v1: whole panels resize to106x106RGBA (26.5world pixels), first30 unmodified pinned centres, deterministic species roster0,1,0,1,2,0,1,3 by point index modulo8 (75percent broadleaf over each full roster); winter remains96x96/36centres with point index modulo4. Constructor rejects any nonzero-alpha resampled RGBA pixel square outside R=hypot(12,12), preserving the original gate and seven-site proof without raster clipping.

rebuild_note: Rebuilt to the user-supplied RefDesign visual target with shared detailed grass, earthworks, roads, crowns, rocks and huts; user visual approval remains open. Historical generation recipes retain their original provenance.
resampling_chain: pinned RGBA atlas -> four whole panels -> premultiplied alpha-aware Lanczos3; summer106x106RGBA, winter96x96RGBA; actual summer painted pixel-square support checked against unchanged R=hypot(12,12)
unchanged grass material samples on opaque 416x352 overscan at (pixel+0.5)/4-4; ordinary Over whole crowns
whole unmasked 4x -> Lanczos3 whole unmasked 208x176 2x; crop four world pixels per side then independent half-open ownership
decode actual exported tile PNGs -> ordinary Over seven-visible-cell fixtures; never repaint patch
runtime_context_selection: UNIMPLEMENTED; canonical forest/forest_w defaults require six seasonal base neighbors. Other adjacency requires matching context profiles; keys are not gameplay IDs. Only fixed fixtures currently exported.

visual_target.role: User-supplied scene target for the current grass, streets, earthworks, rocks, hut and summer canopy. Reference bytes are not runtime artwork.
